dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Phew... Komore Teahouse is such a great place to drink tea. If only I had an old classical text on hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About books from the past...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Youngster, are you also interested in old tomes as well? Not bad. Kids like you are rare.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: You have to read the these old classics slowly. Nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm sorry. It's not that I disapprove of the younger generation. It's just the fact that Yae Publishing House has been focusing on Light Literature recently... I really can't accept that.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Pondering, thinking, and coming up with the right words are all part of the fun of literature.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Using simple and forgettable pleasures to win readers over... I don't think it's a good trend...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Komore Teahouse...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: It's hard to find a classy tea house in Inazuma nowadays. Indeed, only when those who understand real culture gather together can we maintain the serenity of this place.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: I heard from Kozue that you were invited by the Kamisato Clan to Komore Teahouse. If Kozue is around, you can feel free to relax here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Taroumaru...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Taroumaru is very cute, eh? He is an old friend of mine. Back in our Shuumatsuban days, we were both well-known hunks, hahaha...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Go on your way. Look for Taroumaru if you need anything from the tea house.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Kozue...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Many people have been taken in by Kozue's weak, girly appearance and have paid the price.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: This girl is not just a talker. She can handle herself really well.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: She is the offspring of the Kamisato Clan's retainers. Her swordsmanship is impeccable. Though she's nowhere near as good as me, haha.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Anyway, with her skills, she is definitely qualified to be the gatekeeper of Komore Teahouse. Perhaps she's even overqualified...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Shuumatsuban?

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Haha, I would be remiss not to mention my grand history if we're going to be talking about that!

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Back in the day, I was an instructor at the ninja village. No one dared to not greet me when they saw me. Taroumaru followed me around back then as well. We served the Kamisato Clan loyally together...

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: Now that both of us have retired, I'm not sure if they can still count on those young'uns... Hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Nakanishi
dialogues.text: They're probably still expecting me to give them a score, I'll bet...
